title: SEC6: hybrid in-process+TCP two-instance harness
description: spawn_test_pair gives alice an in-process router (axum oneshot, no TCP) and bob a real TLS TCP listener. This split is non-obvious but well-chosen: alice's owner-API calls avoid all network overhead and TLS setup, while bob's listener exercises the real TLS accept path that outbox_worker uses in production. A fully in-process pair would not test TLS delivery at all; two real TCP listeners would double setup cost. The asymmetry is intentional and documented in the harness module comment.
